steps.title: Prepare 1 M Potassium Phosphate Buffer (pH 6)
steps.instruction: Prepare a pH 6.0 potassium phosphate buffer stock solution.

substeps.instruction: Combine 132 mL of 1 M K2HPO4 and 868 mL of 1 M KH2PO4.
Confirm pH is 6.0 and adjust using phosphoric acid or KOH.
Sterilize by autoclaving for 20 minutes on a liquid cycle program.
Store at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare 13.4% YNB Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a filter-sterilized YNB with ammonium sulfate stock solution.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 134 g of yeast nitrogen base (YNB) with ammonium sulfate and without amino acids in 1.000 L of water (heat if necessary to dissolve completely). Alternatively, use 34 g of YNB without ammonium sulfate and amino acids and 100 g of ammonium sulfate.
Sterilize by filtration.
Store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 0.02% Biotin Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a filter-sterilized biotin stock solution.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 20 mg biotin in 100 mL of water.
Sterilize by filtration.
Store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare BMGY and BMMY Media
steps.instruction: Prepare the growth media using the prepared stock solutions.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve 10 g of yeast extract and 20 g of peptone in 700 mL of water.
Cool to room temperature.
Add 100 mL of 1 M potassium phosphate buffer (pH 6), 100 mL of 13.4% YNB stock, and 2 mL of 0.02% biotin stock.
For BMGY: Add 100 mL of 10% glycerol.
For BMMY: Add 100 mL of 5% methanol.
Store at 4 °C for up to 2 months if not used immediately.

steps.title: Inoculate and Grow Primary Culture
steps.instruction: Start the culture from a single colony.

substeps.instruction: Inoculate 25 mL of BMGY in a 250 mL shake flask with a single colony of K. phaffii GS115 containing the desired construct.
Incubate at 28 °C (or 30 °C) with 250 RPM shaking until saturation.

steps.title: Prepare Saturated Pre-culture
steps.instruction: Expand the culture to create a saturated pre-culture.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 2.5 mL of the saturated culture into 100 mL BMGY in a 500 mL low-baffle shake flask.
Grow overnight at 28 °C (or 30 °C).
Measure the OD600 of the overnight culture.

steps.title: Normalize Pre-culture Density
steps.instruction: Concentrate the cells to a specific OD600.

substeps.instruction: Pellet 50 mL of the culture in a 50 mL falcon tube at 4000 x g for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in BMMY medium to a final OD600 of 50 using the formula: V_BMMY = (OD600,measured * V_pre-culture) / 50.

steps.title: Inoculate Expression Culture
steps.instruction: Start the expression culture in BMMY.

substeps.instruction: Inoculate 100 mL BMMY medium with 2 mL of the normalized pre-culture to achieve a starting OD600 of 1.

steps.title: Induce Protein Expression with Methanol
steps.instruction: Maintain induction by adding methanol periodically.

substeps.instruction: Add 1% methanol (1 mL of 100% methanol to 100 mL culture) approximately 24 hours after inoculation.
Repeat the 1% methanol addition every 24 hours.

steps.title: Harvest Cells
steps.instruction: Collect the cells for downstream processing.

substeps.instruction: Harvest cells by centrifugation at 4000 x g for 10 minutes at 4 °C.
Discard the supernatant (Note: original text says 'discard the pellets', but context implies discarding supernatant to keep cells).
Keep samples on ice during processing and store at 4 °C or -20 °C.
